```sql
SELECT SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS net_revenue
FROM analytics.fct_orders
JOIN analytics.dim_date ON analytics.fct_orders.order_date_local = analytics.dim_date.date_day
WHERE analytics.dim_date.fiscal_year = 2026
  AND analytics.fct_orders.status != 'cancelled';
```

```sql
SELECT 
    f.region,
    SUM(f.net_revenue_eur) AS net_revenue
FROM 
    analytics.fct_orders f
JOIN 
    analytics.dim_date d 
    ON d.date_day = f.order_date_local
WHERE 
    d.calendar_month = 3 
    AND d.calendar_year = 2026
    AND f.status != 'cancelled'
GROUP BY 
    f.region
ORDER BY 
    f.region;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    o.channel,
    SUM(o.net_revenue_eur) AS net_revenue_eur
FROM 
    analytics.fct_orders o
JOIN 
    analytics.dim_date d ON o.order_date_local = d.date_day
WHERE 
    d.calendar_year = 2025
    AND o.status != 'cancelled'
GROUP BY 
    o.channel
ORDER BY 
    net_revenue_eur DESC;
```

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM analytics.dim_customers
JOIN analytics.dim_date ON analytics.dim_customers.first_order_on = analytics.dim_date.date_day
WHERE analytics.dim_date.fiscal_year = 2026
  AND analytics.dim_customers.first_order_on IS NOT NULL;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    o.region,
    SUM(f.net_revenue_eur) AS net_revenue_eur,
    SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM 
    analytics.fct_orders o
JOIN 
    analytics.fct_order_lines f ON o.order_id = f.order_id
JOIN 
    analytics.dim_date d ON o.order_date_local = d.date_day
WHERE 
    d.calendar_year = 2025
    AND o.status != 'cancelled'
GROUP BY 
    o.region
ORDER BY 
    o.region;
```

```sql
SELECT SUM(ol.net_amount_eur) AS net_revenue
FROM analytics.fct_order_lines ol
JOIN analytics.fct_orders f ON ol.order_id = f.order_id
JOIN analytics.dim_products p ON ol.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN analytics.dim_date d ON f.order_date_local = d.date_day
WHERE p.product_name LIKE '%tent%'
  AND d.calendar_year = 2025
  AND f.status != 'cancelled';
```

```sql
SELECT SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS total_revenue
FROM analytics.fct_orders
WHERE order_date_local >= '2025-01-01' 
  AND order_date_local < '2026-01-01'
  AND status != 'cancelled';
```

```sql
SELECT 
    o.region,
    AVG(o.net_revenue_eur) AS average_order_value
FROM 
    analytics.fct_orders o
JOIN 
    analytics.dim_date d ON o.order_date_local = d.date_day
WHERE 
    d.calendar_month = 3 AND d.calendar_year = 2026
    AND o.status != 'cancelled'
GROUP BY 
    o.region;
```
